purpose: Teach: 池上/浅井/塩野/大村/亀山/成瀬/中沢/川村

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 池上部長の歓迎会を準備しましょう
lines.en: Let's get the welcome reception organized for Director Ikekami.
lines.style: Purposeful, clear. Opening with calm authority. Steady pace, each word distinct. The tone of someone delegating something she's already thought through.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。浅井課長の引き継ぎ書を確認します
lines.en: Got it. I'll check over Manager Asai's handover notes.
lines.style: Responsive, immediate. No hesitation in the commitment. Warm agreement — the sound of someone who knows what's needed and is already moving.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 塩野技術主任のプロジェクト進捗を共有しましょう
lines.en: And let's share the project progress from Shiono, our tech lead.
lines.style: Directive but collaborative. Slight lift on 'share' — inviting input. Measured pace. The voice of someone making sure nothing falls between the cracks.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。大村広報の月次企画書を確認します
lines.en: Understood. I'll review the monthly proposal from Omura in PR.
lines.style: Brisk acknowledgment. Quick, competent. The rhythm of checking off a list. Warm undertone — not robotic, just efficient and ready for the next thing.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 亀山顧問との面談を予定しましょう
lines.en: Let's schedule a meeting with Kameyama, our advisor.
lines.style: Clear and purposeful. Slight emphasis on 'schedule' — moving things forward. Calm, measured delivery. The voice of someone keeping momentum without rushing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。成瀬経理の決算予定を整えます
lines.en: Yes. I'll get the closing schedule from Naruse in accounting squared away.
lines.style: Prompt and assured. Light, capable energy. Quick delivery without being curt. The assurance of someone who knows exactly what needs to happen next.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 中沢人事に新人研修プランを依頼しましょう
lines.en: Let's ask Nakasawa from HR to put together a new employee training plan.
lines.style: Directive and clear. Deliberate pace. The opening slightly weighted — this is important. Composed, not rushed. The tone of delegating something that matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。川村法務に新契約レビューを依頼します
lines.en: Will do. I'll ask Kawamura from legal to review the new contracts.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Quick, decisive. Slight finality in the delivery — closing out the list. Warm undertone. The sound of wrapping up with confidence.
